cases._comment: P4.D268 (v4 d58548051): Speaker Two's ONLY memory naming Carol is COLD (0.99, vector-less). v4's semantic search (hot-only, incl. its own text fallback) finds nothing, so loadMemoriesForParticipant's text fallback runs, reads the cold row from searchByContent, and SKIPS it (`if (memory.tier === 'cold') continue`) — Carol gets no memories and nothing is stamped. Red on a P4.D268-only branch (KEYSTONE's semantic text fallback is not hot-filtered — P4.D267); on the union it pins the skip.
